title: Distributed-Proofs
tagline: Distributed_Proofs Transparent Legal System for DAOs used for multiple use cases for agreements or a set of commands with recorded verifiable proofs
description: * Build a simple platform verifying the data using a smart contract which records a proof representing the status of data (File or Document) and binding it to verifiable source matching it 1:1 as an NFT. The file will have an agreement for DAOs this can be used as a Distributed system shared across a DAOs.
how_its_made:
A various a technologies from backend, frontend, and leveraging blockchain tech: (Smart contracts, NFTs, and DAOs.)


What is needed is the following:
Step-1: For the data shared, create a data structure which stores it
Step-2: Take data from the agreement and record each commit (Add, edit and delete, even when assigning witnesses prior) from the file.
Step-3: An agreement is sent to a user in  DAO or through a DAO.
Step-4: The user can assign can others before signing an agreement with as they are present and all this is recorded on the blockchain.
Step-5: An agreement and anyone involved must verified ahead of time and the Data integrity must be verified As this is made to a smart contract and NFT issued to making sure the data’s integrity is not tampered with and everything traces back to a truthful structure used as a distributed proof.
